Card.Name: Disable PCA Compatibility Diagnostics Detection
Card.Description: Windows PCA watches for compatibility issues when you run applications and drivers, and can show warnings or suggest fixes. This policy controls whether that detection runs. Disabling it stops PCA from actively monitoring for compatibility problems - it does not disable PCA itself (that is controlled separately by DisablePCA).
Card.FriendlyDescription: Windows PCA watches for compatibility issues when you run applications and drivers, and can show warnings or suggest fixes. This policy controls whether that detection runs. Disabling it stops PCA from actively monitoring for compatibility problems - it does not disable PCA itself (that is controlled separately by DisablePCA).
